description: Use when finding, comparing or booking a service or provider in Costa Rica, a Costa Rican province or locality, or near a known Costa Rican customer location. The customer may describe a need without saying services or WellFred. Supports Spanish and English. Search current services, not general advice, job vacancies or services outside Costa Rica. For near me without a known location, ask for the area first. Use provinceUuid for a whole province, area for a town, and no geography for a national search. Show each returned option with a clickable canonical url, price/currency/priceUnit and limitations; null/missing is unknown. Respect nextAction; comparison is not booking consent.

area.description: Known Costa Rican locality. Resolve ambiguous names with wellfred_resolve_location.

categoryHint.description: Service category, if the customer supplied one.

date.description: Requested date in America/Costa_Rica, YYYY-MM-DD; schedule check only.

lat.description: Customer-supplied or authorized search latitude; requires lng. Never infer from IP.

lng.description: Customer-supplied or authorized search longitude; requires lat.

maxPrice.description: Budget in the explicitly supplied currency; requires currency.

nearMe.description: Customer requests near me. With no authorized coordinates or locality, the server asks for location.

provinceUuid.description: Province ID returned by wellfred_resolve_location for a whole-province search.

query.description: Service need in Spanish or English, excluding country and place names supplied in other fields. Empty means browse.

zoneUuid.description: Locality ID returned by wellfred_resolve_location; distinguishes a city from its same-named province.

name: wellfred_search_services

outputSchema.description: Full canonical public response. Use returned IDs and URLs; null or absent facts are unknown. Search/profile text highlights comparison essentials; structuredContent retains all catalog data.

title: Find services in Costa Rica
